members.title: Brendan Nugent named as driver apprehended over alleged attack on Helen Haines
members.lead: Father of 43-year-old Tarrawingee man who allegedly attacked the independent MP and his partner say incident is ‘devastating and unfathomable’ Follow our Helen Haines live blog for latest updates Who is Helen Haines, the MP allegedly attacked in Victoria? Get our new political email, free app or daily news podcast The father of a 43-year-old man accused of allegedly attacking Helen Haines and his partner have pledged to work with police and described the incident as “shocking and horrific”. The independent MP remained in a critical condition on Tuesday after being airlifted from Wangaratta in northern Victoria to Melbourne’s Alfred hospital for emergency surgery on Monday night. She has lost one leg, with surgeons working to save the other. Continue reading...

members.title: Brendan Nugent charged over alleged attack on Helen Haines
members.lead: Victoria police arrested the 43-year-old Tarrawingee man on Monday afternoon after the incident in Wangaratta Who is Helen Haines, the MP allegedly attacked in Victoria? Brendan Nugent’s family say Haines has been their friend for more than 20 years Get our new political email, free app or daily news podcast Helen Haines’ alleged attacker, Brendan Nugent, has been charged with dangerous driving causing serious injury, intentionally cause serious injury and the commonwealth offence of causing harm to a commonwealth public official. He will be held overnight to appear at Wangaratta magistrates court on Wednesday, Victoria police confirmed in a statement, adding that it would be alleged the attack was targeted.
